title: SATURDAY EASY CARDIO
subtitle: SATURDAY. TIMED AND EASY. STEP-UPS, REVERSE LUNGES, SLOW STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS, BIRD-DOG BALANCE, FIGURE-FOUR, HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH. WARM THE ENGINE, OPEN THE HIPS, NO HEROICS.

script.welcome: SATURDAY, GRIMES. EASY CARDIO. EASY MEANS STEADY, NOT ABSENT. SIXTEEN MINUTES ON THE CLOCK. WE GET THE BLOOD MOVING, TEST THE BALANCE, THEN OPEN THOSE RUSTY HIPS. THE SOFA CAN WAIT. IT ALWAYS DOES.
script.rest: REST. WALK IT OFF. NO SITTING DOWN, IT IS A SLIPPERY SLOPE.
script.lastSet: LAST ONE. FINISH CLEAN. EYES ON YOU.
script.complete: DISMISSED. HEART RATE UP, BALANCE TESTED, HIPS OPEN. THAT IS A PROPER SATURDAY. GO ENJOY THE WEEKEND, AND IF THERE IS A CHEESE BOARD, A SMALL PLATE, SOLDIER. WEIGH IN MONDAY. I'M WATCHING.
script.pause: HOLD. CATCH YOUR BREATH. I'M WATCHING.

exercises.name: STEP-UPS (BOTTOM STAIR, TIMED)
exercises.cue: BOTTOM STAIR. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, DRIVE THROUGH THE HEEL, STAND TALL AT THE TOP, STEP DOWN UNDER CONTROL. ALTERNATE LEADING LEGS. STEADY CONVERSATIONAL PACE FOR 30 SECONDS. RAIL IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: STEP UPS. BOTTOM STAIR. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH. WHOLE FOOT ON THE STEP, STAND TALL, STEP DOWN SOFT. SWAP THE LEAD LEG. STEADY PACE. THIS IS A STROLL WITH AMBITION, NOT A SPRINT.
exercises.speakDone: STEP UPS DONE. ENGINE WARM. GOOD.

exercises.name: REVERSE LUNGES (TIMED, ALTERNATING)
exercises.cue: STAND TALL, HAND ON A CHAIR OR WALL IF NEEDED. STEP ONE FOOT BACK, LOWER THE BACK KNEE TOWARD THE FLOOR, FRONT KNEE OVER THE LACES. PUSH THROUGH THE FRONT HEEL TO STAND. ALTERNATE LEGS FOR 30 SECONDS. SHALLOW IS FINE.
exercises.speakStart: REVERSE LUNGES. THREE ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS. ALTERNATE LEGS. STEP BACK, SINK, DRIVE UP. HAND ON THE CHAIR IF YOU LIKE. SHALLOW IS LEGAL. COLLAPSING IN A HEAP IS NOT.
exercises.speakDone: LUNGES DONE. LEGS ON PARADE. GOOD.

exercises.name: SLOW STAIR MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS (5TH STAIR)
exercises.cue: HANDS ON THE 5TH STAIR, BODY IN A STRAIGHT INCLINE PLANK. DRIVE ONE KNEE TOWARD THE STEP, RETURN, SWITCH. SLOW AND CONTROLLED, HIPS LEVEL, NO BOUNCING. 20 SECONDS.
exercises.speakStart: MOUNTAIN CLIMBERS. FIFTH STEP. THREE ROUNDS. TWENTY SECONDS. SLOW MARCH. KNEE IN, KNEE BACK, HIPS LEVEL. YOU ARE CLIMBING A HILL, NOT FLEEING A BAR TAB.

exercises.name: BIRD-DOG BALANCE
exercises.cue: ALL FOURS, HANDS UNDER SHOULDERS, KNEES UNDER HIPS. REACH ONE ARM FORWARD AND THE OPPOSITE LEG BACK UNTIL LEVEL. HOLD 2 SECONDS, HIPS SQUARE, NO TWIST. RETURN AND SWITCH. 6 PER SIDE.
exercises.speakStart: BIRD DOG. BALANCE WORK. TWO ROUNDS. SIX EACH SIDE. OPPOSITE ARM, OPPOSITE LEG, REACH LONG. HOLD TWO. HIPS SQUARE. WOBBLE ALL YOU LIKE, BUT DO NOT TIP OVER LIKE A DRUNK CORPORAL.
exercises.speakRest: TWENTY. SIT BACK ON YOUR HEELS.
exercises.speakDone: BALANCE DONE. STEADIER EVERY WEEK. I NOTICED.

exercises.name: FIGURE-FOUR HIP STRETCH
exercises.cue: SIT TALL ON A STURDY CHAIR OR LIE ON YOUR BACK. CROSS ONE ANKLE OVER THE OPPOSITE KNEE. KEEP THE SPINE LONG AND HINGE GENTLY FORWARD (OR DRAW THE KNEE IN) UNTIL YOU FEEL THE OUTER HIP AND GLUTE. BREATHE. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: FIGURE FOUR. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. ANKLE OVER KNEE, LONG SPINE, LEAN IN GENTLY. FEEL THE OUTSIDE OF THE HIP. BREATHE. THIS IS WHERE THE DESK CHAIR HIDES ITS DAMAGE.

exercises.name: HIP-FLEXOR STRETCH WITH REACH
exercises.cue: HALF-KNEELING (CUSHION UNDER THE KNEE) OR A STAGGERED STANCE HOLDING A CHAIR. TUCK THE TAILBONE, SQUEEZE THE BACK GLUTE, SHIFT GENTLY FORWARD. REACH THE SAME-SIDE ARM OVERHEAD AND A LITTLE AWAY. HOLD 30, SWITCH.
exercises.speakStart: HIP FLEXOR STRETCH. TWO ROUNDS. THIRTY SECONDS EACH SIDE. TUCK THE TAIL, SQUEEZE THE BACK CHEEK, SHIFT FORWARD. ARM UP AND OVER. A WEEK OF SITTING, UNDONE IN ONE MINUTE. YOU ARE WELCOME.
exercises.speakDone: HIPS OPEN. THAT IS SATURDAY DONE. DISMISSED.
